name: Routr
description: Cloud-native, lightweight SIP proxy, location server, and registrar for carriers, communication service providers, and integrators. Supports programmable routing, load balancing, and multi-tenant deployments.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker Compose configuration with PostgreSQL integration. Port mappings for SIP (5060/UDP) and gRPC API (51908). Helm charts available for Kubernetes.

eval_notes: Modern programmable SIP server with excellent Docker support. Good for SIP routing configuration and telephony automation evals. Modern cloud-native SIP server with 1.7k stars. TypeScript-based with gRPC API, making it easy to integrate with agentic systems. Programmable routing and multi-tenant support enable complex telephony evaluation scenarios.
